latest.notes:
Fixes Replace Audio when the old file has already been removed.

• Replacing a batch by deleting the old files first, dropping the replacements into the station folder and then using Replace Audio did not work: the element kept pointing at the old, now-missing path while the new audio sat unused. Nothing to trash is no longer treated as a failure.
• If the old file IS still there and genuinely can't be moved to the Trash, the replacement still rolls back, so you're never left with two files and an element pointing at the wrong one.

Includes everything in v0.5.81: sortable Library columns and the warning when an element loses its audio file.
